assessments.identity: Official current landing links September 2026 master list; freshly downloaded 244-page PDF identical SHA to round99. Page 168 visually checked: Pentagonite, CaV4+OSi4O10(H2O)3·H2O, A 1971-039. Approval is not criticality.
assessments.inspected: PDF page 168 plus page1 status definitions; no extra external identifier asserted.
Both complete originals, 7 and 13 pages, text and relevant rendered pages. Staples pages 405-407 and 408-411; Evans pages 415-416, Table 4, topology pages 419-422.
assessments.limits: Pentagonite elemental ratios were semi-quantitative; historical water inferred from unit-cell comparisons and structure, not precise direct water assay. Original twins complicated measurement, then superior untwinned crystal used. Ccm21 is pentagonite; Pcmn/Pnma is cavansite. Staples low-temperature pentagonite inference from paragenesis is not a controlled formation experiment. No acid-extraction yield adopted from qualitative chemical tests. Shared Oregon investigation not independent replication.

assessments.inspected: Complete 12-page original; methods pages 242-244, Table1, Figures 1-3, 5, 6, results pages 245-247, hydrogen/formation discussion pages 248-251. Figures 1/5 and chemical/refinement tables visually checked. Current J-STAGE landing and Crossref metadata checked; landing hasSupplementary material (0).
assessments.claims: Natural Wagholi powder, air 10 C/min, 10 mg TG-DTA to 900 C; separate XRPD aliquots and 5 mg ESR. Source-assigned 16.07 wt% water loss, thermal peaks 95/220/280 C; 1.73 wt% gain near 600 C assigned to oxidation. Figure 5 retains diffraction after 550 C cooling, with a terminal amorphous product at 700 C. No observed reversible cavansite/pentagonite conversion.
assessments.limits: Initial XRD impurity nondetection is not absolute phase purity. No thermal replicate uncertainty or evolved-gas verification stated. H positions were not refined; ESR-silent V5+ is not excluded by V4+ signal alone. Regained water mass was not measured. Intermediate amorphous abstract scope is ambiguous, not a direct contradiction claim. Natural formation hypothesis contested by 2025 fieldwork. Existing closed issue 362 and corrected cavansite review read.

assessments.inspected: Newly acquired Unimore 45-page Revised_version.pdf: repository cover and 44 manuscript pages, Figures 1-7/S8, Tables 1-4/S5-S8 present. Relevant Figures 2, 4, 6, 7/S8 and Tables 1B, 3A, 3B/S7/S8 visually inspected. Unimi 22-page Pentagonite_R1..pdf is text only from the same 2015 study, not the 2013 paper. Institutional version label AAM checked.
assessments.claims: Different natural Wagholi specimens, powder m.e.w. 16:3:1 or oil DAC up to 8.26/8.35 GPa, single-crystal refinements at 1.51/2.04 GPa. Added O10 assigned to water. Powder transition brackets 2.45-2.96 GPa (m.e.w.) and 1.27-1.71 GPa (oil); orthorhombic cell recovered on release. Single-crystal irreversible failure above about 2.5 GPa preserved.
assessments.limits: Final publisher PDF not checked. Poor oil patterns and probable nonhydrostatic compression above 1 GPa; Le Bail cell indexing is not a triclinic atomic structure. Table S7 O10 occupancy 0.94(3)/0.96(3) makes ideal five-water formulas approximate. Disorder and restraints; no independent water mass balance. Table 1B size heading mm versus actual cell micrometres flagged. Tables and figures are not independent studies.

assessments.inspected: Full 27-page publisher original, methods pages 4-5, paragenesis pages 15-18, thermobarometric discussion pages 19-23, conclusion 24. Relevant pages 5, 21, 24 rendered.
assessments.claims: Later field/paragenetic study contests mandatory high-temperature formation. Usable fluid-inclusion measurements were obtained only for calcite; no pentagonite/cavansite thermometry.
assessments.limits: Abstract 0.01-0.03 GPa versus conclusion 0.1-0.3 GPa conflict retained; neither adopted. Original 2025 supplement landing failed; no individual EDX/XRD cells or morphological twinning count imported. This is not a controlled repeat of the 2009 thermal arm. CC BY 4.0 main text; no raw PDF committed.

assessments.inspected: Crossref and Elsevier API metadata verify 197:508-516, January 2013, title and authors. Elsevier response HTTP 200 contains only 1842 bytes of core metadata, no original text. ScienceDirect 403, DOI web route error; bounded Bern/institutional search did not acquire an original.
